'''Azuragon''' is a continent in Avant. The extracted Miraheze source identifies the [[Federated Syndicates of Veszprem]] as being located in north-east Azuragon.

This draft is a minimal bridge page for the 1994-back lore port. It exists to keep geographic references connected while leaving the continent's borders, internal regions, and full state roster open for map-confirmed expansion.

== Known References ==

The clearest current reference is Veszprem. By 1994, Veszprem was an isolationist industrial state in north-east Azuragon shaped by the [[Veszprem Invasion]], the [[Syndicate Revolution of 1949]], and [[Unified Orderism]].

== Open Map Work ==

Azuragon should be expanded after checking the 2003 and 2022 map references. The final article should identify its major regions, neighboring waters, historical states, modern states, and Great War-era boundaries without inventing borders from text alone.
